color}]}`; `status` the same with each option's `group`; `date` `{date_format,

cleared.description: Values cleared by a type change or by removed options.

has_content.description: The row page has body text.

values.description:
Values by property id, stored and computed (relations, rollups); a missing property is
empty.

a person value and `{"start": "today", "end": null}` as a date where the template uses
them.

name.description: What "New" lists, 1 to 200 characters.

DatabaseTemplate.description:
A row template: a hidden page of the database whose title, icon, values and body fill a new
row.

DatabaseViewConfig.description:
A view's saved layout. Rules, sorts, columns and cards that name a deleted property are dropped
when the view is read and saved. The `group_*`, `hidden_groups` and `card_properties` fields
belong to board views.

calculations.description:
Table: the footer calculation of each property that has one. A function that does not fit
the property's type (after a type change) is dropped.

calendar_mode.description: Calendar: a month grid (default) or one week.

card_preview.description: Gallery: what a card shows above its title (default: the body's first image or text).

card_properties.description: Board: the properties shown on each card, in order. The title always shows.

columns.description: The order of the properties; properties missing here show at the end.

date_property_id.description:
Calendar: the `date`, `created_time` or `last_edited_time` property that places the rows.

default_template_id.description:
The template that "New" and "+" use in this view (`null`: an empty row). A deleted
template reads as `null`.

end_property_id.description:
Timeline: the `date` property where a bar ends. Without one, a date range's end is the
end and a single date is a one-day bar.

fit_image.description: Gallery: the preview image fits its box instead of filling it.

oneOf.description: Form: the questions and texts (spec P3 18). Only form views have one.

group_by.description:
Board: the `select`, `status`, `multi_select` or `person` property whose groups are the
columns (a card with several values shows in each of their columns). A board without one
falls back to the first status, else the first select property.

group_order.description:
Board: group ids in column order (option ids, or user ids for a person), `null` for the
"No <property>" column. Groups missing here follow in the property's order.

hidden_groups.description: Board: group ids (or `null`) of the columns listed under "Hidden groups".

hidden_sub_groups.description: Board: group ids (or `null`) of the hidden lanes.

hide_empty_groups.description: Board: hides the columns and lanes that have no cards.

show_table.description: Timeline: the table pane left of the bars shows (absent: `true`).

start_property_id.description:
Timeline: the `date` property where a bar starts. A timeline without one takes the first
`date` property.

sub_group_by.description:
Board: the property whose groups are the lanes (rows of the same columns): a `select`,
`status`, `multi_select`, `person` or `checkbox` property other than `group_by`. A
checkbox's groups are `"true"` and `"false"`.

sub_group_order.description: Board: group ids in lane order, as `group_order`.

table_columns.description: Timeline: the properties of the table pane, after the title.

email.description: The account's current email, typed again to confirm.

password.description:
Required when the account has a password. An account without one confirms with a session that signed in
(or confirmed with a provider) in the last 10 minutes, else 401 `reauthentication_required`.

DeliveryRecord.description: One click that Orbit sent to a webhook's request URL.

error.description: Why there was no good answer: `timeout`, `refused`, `blocked_address`, …

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer; null when there was none.

sub_issues.description: Optional in stored and received states (default `nested`).

DocKind.description: What a collaborative document belongs to.

include_children.description: Also copy the page's live sub-pages (the whole subtree, in order). Defaults to `false`.

code.description: A code the authenticator app shows now.

code_verifier.description: The verifier whose S256 challenge went to start.

handoff.description: The one-time code from the callback redirect.

name.description: What the user calls it, e.g. "MacBook" or "YubiKey".

ForwardedRecord.description:

user.description: The member who wrote it; for an integration's message, the member who set it up.

next_before.description: Send it as `before` for the older page; null on the oldest page.

columns.description: One per CSV column, in order (at most 100). Exactly one maps to the title property.

dry_run.description: Converts and counts without writing anything.

rows.description: Cell text per row (at most 5,000 rows); a row may be shorter than `columns`.

attachments.description: Slack's legacy attachments: boxes with a colored bar, title, text and fields.

blocks.description:
Block Kit blocks (`header`, `section`, `context`, `image`, `divider`, `markdown`,
`rich_text`) shown in place of `text`. Other block types are left out.

icon_emoji.description: The avatar of this message only as an emoji (`:ghost:`); it wins over `icon_url`.

icon_url.description: The avatar of this message only: an https image. Other URLs are ignored.

mrkdwn.description: `false` shows `text` as it is, without formatting (Slack's `mrkdwn`).

text.description:

thread_ts.description: The id of a root message in the webhook's channel: the message is a reply in its thread.

the workspace mail API refuses with `mail_disabled`.

environment.description:

here gives 409 `set_by_environment`.

registration_ready.description: Registration can open: a mail server or (not on Orbit Cloud) a sign-in provider confirms new emails.

channels.description: The private channels a guest invitation adds the guest to; empty for other roles.

Bytes of files one workspace may store: attachments, page and chat files, emoji and stickers. A file is
counted once per workspace, however often it is attached.

Why the last attempt failed: `http_status`, `timeout`, `unreachable`, `blocked_address`,

last_status.description: The HTTP status of the last answer; null when there was none.

events.description:
Members' messages in the channel are sent to the request URL, and the webhook's secret
can read the channel. Always false without a request URL.

icon_url.description: An https image for the avatar of its messages; null for the default one.

name.description: The author name of its messages, unless a message sets `username`.

request_url.description: Where clicks on its buttons go; null when its buttons are not interactive.

signing_secret.description: `whsec_…`: verifies the `webhook-signature` header from now on. Shown once.

WebhookUpdateBody.description: Omitted fields keep their value. Turning a subscription off cancels its pending deliveries.

WorkspaceAccess.description: What members of a workspace may do.

WorkspaceBucketView.description: The S3 bucket that a workspace connected for its own files.

checking.description:
Orbit has not counted the files to move since the bucket was saved or removed yet; `files_to_move` is 0
until it has.

files_to_move.description:
The workspace's files still waiting to move into the bucket (or back out of it): existing files on this
server and in the installation's bucket move in the background.

move_error.description: Why moving files stopped last time. Orbit retries every ten minutes.

removing.description: The bucket was removed: its files move back to the installation's storage, then it disappears.

oneOf.description: `null` while the workspace uses the installation's storage.

expires_at.description: The archive is deleted at this time.

requested_by_name.description: The member who started it; `null` when the account is gone.

size_bytes.description: Size of the ZIP archive once it is ready.

items.description: The newest exports first, without expired ones.

permissions.description: What the caller's role may do in this workspace.

WorkspaceStorage.description: How many bytes of files a workspace stores, and its quota.

file_count.description: How many files the workspace stores; `0` unless the caller may update the workspace.

largest_files.description:
One page of the files that use the most storage, largest first. Empty unless the caller may update the
workspace.

used_bytes.description:
Each stored file once, however often it is attached. A deleted file stops counting about a day after its
last reference goes (trashed tasks, pages and messages keep their files until the trash is emptied).
